dataset: Chen et al., Cell 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2021.05.026; Zenodo 6713616
status: analysis specification frozen before extracting numerical values from the source archive; not outcome-blind to the publication's qualitative conclusions
population: simultaneous bilateral ALM recording sessions with unilateral photoinhibition
primary_question: Do control-trial interhemispheric interaction features predict perturbation recovery and behavioral robustness within the same recording-and-perturbation sessions?
predictors_control_trials_only: published control-trial inferred interhemispheric influence in the weakly selective state
published control-trial inferred interhemispheric influence in the highly selective state
state-dependence contrast = weak-state influence minus high-state influence
outcomes: recovery of choice information after contralateral photoinhibition
behavioral performance on unilateral photoinhibition trials
primary_statistic: mouse-blocked leave-one-mouse-out prediction of perturbation outcome from the state-dependence contrast, compared with simpler control-only baselines when source processed quantities permit
secondary_statistics: bootstrap confidence intervals clustered by mouse
inferential_unit: mouse for primary generalization/inference; sessions are repeated observations within mouse
success_criterion: positive leave-one-mouse-out association and positive out-of-sample R2 for at least one perturbation outcome, with concordant clustered association
scope_note: If the public scripts/archive expose only author-derived summary arrays rather than raw trial-level values, the analysis will be reported explicitly as an independent numerical reanalysis of source-derived processed quantities, not a de novo raw-data replication.
